posts.title: I Don't Think I Want to Write Romance
posts.description: I published my debut MM romance novella LUNGS in June. It's about 23k words, and it's sold about 5 copies. Plus a cery fun fact, a paperback copy of it sold not that long ago. So now, counting mine, there are two (!!) physical copies of this book out in the world! Very, very cool! I also wrote up a post-mortem on LUNGS in July, in which I go into a bit about how it doesn't really feel like a roman

posts.title: Adventures in Making a Personal Fanfic Archive in 11ty
posts.description: So as you might know, I have a personal fanfiction archive hosted on bearblog , 10001 Nightmares Party .
